name: kettlebell plyo push-up
description: An explosive push-up with one hand on a stable kettlebell handle and the other on the floor, challenging chest power on uneven supports.
instructions: Set one kettlebell securely on the floor and grip its handle with one hand; place your other hand on the floor.
Step back into a plank and lower your chest between your hands.
Press up explosively, briefly taking pressure off both hands, and land softly back on the same supports.
Keep the kettlebell from tipping; complete the set and switch sides.
